title: On Semisymmetric Height and a Multidimensional Generalization of Weighted Catalan Numbers
summary: Weighted Catalan numbers are a class of weighted sums over Dyck paths. Well-studied for their arithmetic properties and applications to enumerative combinatorics, these numbers were recently generalized to the setting of $k$-dimensional Catalan numbers for $k \geq 2$. In this paper, we introduce the $k$-dimensional semisymmetric weighted Catalan numbers ($k$-dimensional SSWCNs), an alternative $k$-dimensional generalization, along with their variant, the $k$-dimensional $u$-bounded semisymmetric weighted Catalan numbers ($k$-dimensional $u$-bounded SSWCNs).
